request: Analyze GSE256241 for PMID 41611847 (An integrated drug repositioning analysis identifies rosiglitazone as a treatment for sarcopenia.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (polyA, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 PE150) of gastrocnemius from aged male C57BL/6JRj mice (S2.8.p1, S4.11.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: 12 mice randomized at 17 months to rosiglitazone diet (0.6 mg/kg/d in AIN-93M, n=6) or plain AIN-93M control diet (n=6) (S4.6.p1; FIG5 C n=6 per group). WGCNA used 5 rosiglitazone + 6 control (FIG5 D, Fig. S3).
final.primary_estimand: Effect of dietary rosiglitazone vs control diet on gastrocnemius gene expression in aged mice. No exercise intervention exists: treadmill (S4.7.p1), rotarod (S4.8.p1) and grip tests (S4.9.p1) are phenotyping assays applied to both groups, not a training arm.
planned_contrasts: rosiglitazone vs control (S2.8.p1; paper: 383 up + 100 down = 483 DEGs)
final.normalization: DESeq2 size factors; pre-filter genes with >1 count per sample and total >12 (S4.13.p1)
final.paper_results: 383 up / 100 down DEGs; Igf1 up; Foxo4, Fbxo32, Trim63 down; fgsea PI3K-Akt up NES 1.68 (S2.8.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper is a drug-repositioning study. Its only transcriptomic experiment (S2.8.p1, S4.11-S4.13) compares rosiglitazone-fed with control-fed aged mice. Exercise appears only as an outcome measure (treadmill exhaustion test, S4.7.p1) and as background in the introduction (S1.p4).

checks: S9.p1 names GSE256241 as the mouse skeletal muscle RNA-seq
12 GSM samples, skeletal muscle, Mus musculus, treatment rosiglitazone 6 / control 6 matches S4.6.p1

ownership.reasoning: Data availability (S9.p1) names GSE256241; sample count, tissue, organism, groups and processing all match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (C3..C15, A6..A25) equal the GEO title field exactly for 12/12 samples (inspect alignment_keys). Treatment comes from characteristics_ch1.1.treatment; the A/C prefixes agree with it.

matrix.reasoning: GSE256241_raw_count.txt.gz: values 0 to 1.75e6, 89.4% integer overall; about 21% of expressed entries are fractional (e.g. 13985.99, 43.85), the signature of StringTie/RSEM-style estimated counts rather than featureCounts integers. data_processing says HISAT2 + StringTie and the file is described as raw counts; the paper used it in DESeq2 (S4.13.p1). Annotation columns gene_name/description/length and empty Unnamed columns are not samples.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists. The only factor is diet treatment (rosiglitazone 6 vs control 6, characteristics_ch1.1.treatment; S4.6.p1). Every mouse was sedentary apart from treadmill/rotarod/grip phenotyping tests given to both groups (S4.7-S4.9), so exercise is neither a factor nor separable from anything. The requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) is not identifiable; the paper's own rosiglitazone-vs-control contrast does not answer the request and is not run as a substitute.
design.reasoning: Request is exercise effect; paper and GEO metadata contain only a drug-vs-control arm. Rejected alternative: running rosiglitazone vs control as an 'exercise-capacity' proxy - rejected because improved treadmill performance is a drug outcome, not an exercise exposure.

candidates.reason_rejected: drug intervention, not exercise; does not answer the requested estimand

discrepancies.paper: rosiglitazone vs control diet in aged mice; exercise only as treadmill phenotyping
discrepancies.data: treatment: rosiglitazone 6 / control 6; no exercise field

discrepancies.paper: 5 rosiglitazone + 6 control for WGCNA (FIG5 D); 6+6 for DESeq2
